title: Japan Ku-area of Tokyo CPI (January 2027, preliminary), 08:30 JST
source: EST: stat.go.jp/english/data/cpi/1582.html ('Consumer Price Index — Schedule of Release', page's own 'Last Update : 23 January 2026'), re-fetched raw direct 2026-09-05 (HTTP 200, 13,839 bytes) and parsed cell-by-cell out of its single 17-row HTML table by this session. Against the header 'Japan: Survey month | Date of release || Ku-area of Tokyo (preliminary): Survey month | Date of release || Remarks', row 14 parses exactly as ['December', 'January 22, 2027', 'January, 2027', 'January 29, 2027', '2026 yearly average of Japan'] — i.e. the Tokyo January-2027 preliminary CPI releases 2027-01-29. That date is a Friday, consistent with the table's 28-of-30 Friday convention, and is clear of Japanese public holidays per the Cabinet Office's own list (www8.cao.go.jp/chosei/shukujitsu/syukujitsu.csv, HTTP 200, 21,538 bytes, Shift-JIS, fetched by this session the same day; the January 2027 holidays are 2027-01-01 and 2027-01-11). By the remark-column rule verified 6/6 on this table by the japan-cpi-2027-03-19 ledger ('of Japan' attaches to the national column, 'of Ku-area of Tokyo' to the Tokyo column), row 14's '2026 yearly average of Japan' belongs to the 2027-01-22 NATIONAL release — so this Tokyo flash carries no supplementary headline. Filed estimate on three counts, identical to every sibling Japanese entry: the confirmed-prefix taxonomy has BLS:/BEA:/CENSUS: for US statistical agencies and no slot for Japan's Statistics Bureau, this lane may not self-confirm an event it discovered in-sweep, and the schedule page's own last-update stamp is 2026-01-23. The 08:30 JST release time is the Statistics Bureau's standing convention and is NOT read off this page — treat it as the weaker half of this entry
notes: DISCOVERED during the japan-cpi-tokyo-flash-2027-02-26 initial-research adjacency sweep (2026-09-05), by walking all 14 future release dates on the parsed Statistics Bureau schedule against this calendar. It was the only Japanese CPI release from 2026-11-27 onward with no entry, and the gap is load-bearing rather than cosmetic: this print is the month-over-month BASE of the Tokyo February flash (japan-cpi-tokyo-flash-2027-02-26, estimate) and therefore the ΔTokyo input of the estimator that ledger registered. That ledger found — replicating the sibling japan-cpi-2027-03-19 arithmetic exactly and then adding the test it never ran — that the Tokyo flash is a poor LEVEL predictor of the national print (0.250pp mean absolute error over 319 months since 2000, losing to simple persistence's 0.182pp) but a strong CHANGE signal: the zero-parameter rule 'last national print + the Tokyo flash's own m/m change' scores 0.117pp over the same 319 months, 0.123pp over 27 Februaries, and survives an expanding-window out-of-sample run with no fitted parameter. The mechanism is a persistent Tokyo-minus-national wedge (lag-1 autocorrelation 0.834) that contaminates the level and cancels in the change. Without THIS release the rule cannot be computed, which is why an untracked 2027-01-29 was a silent single point of failure. Registered as FT-japan-cpi-tokyo-flash-2027-02-26-3 (this release publishes 2027-01-29, score by 2027-01-30). Also of note: together with the national January print (japan-cpi-2027-02-19, estimate) and the Tokyo February flash, this is one of the three readings the Bank of Japan's 2027-03-18 board holds — the combination that pins national February core to ~0.123pp against the stale January print's 0.178pp. Impact is LOW: no house playbook is keyed to Japanese prices, symbols is empty, and the value is calibration rather than a price channel.
